result.brief: 提出可修正的扩散缓存框架 PoSTCache：用后续完整计算步的反馈反向校正被跳过步的预测，并给出基于后验方差缩减的锚点选择策略，在图像与视频生成模型上提升质量-效率权衡。
result.reason: Training-free diffusion caching acceleration applied to image and video generation models; directly serves video generation efficiency, though it is a sampling-time method rather than a representation contribution.
